$comment: Where to register, for the in-depth guides whose research records keep this inside their steps. Each path is quoted from the guide's own first registration step; each URL is the console named in that step or the guide's own registration source.

google-workspace.path: Google Cloud console → Google Auth Platform → Get started (Audience: External), then Clients → Create client → Web application, in separate dev and prod projects.

microsoft-365.path: entra.microsoft.com → Entra ID → App registrations → New registration, with supported account types set to “Multiple Entra ID tenants”.

slack.path: api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest, owned by your company workspace.

github.path: Org → Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New GitHub App (a GitHub App owned by your organization, not an OAuth App).

notion.path: app.notion.com/developers/connections → Build → Public connections → Create new connection, with Installation scope set to Any workspace.

meta.path: developers.facebook.com → My Apps → Create App, with the Pages, Messenger and Instagram use cases, connected to your verified business portfolio.
